def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Draw the divider beside the colored shape, across its full height.
    color=next((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (1,2)), None)

    left,right=min(cols),max(cols)
    if right < len(grid[0])-1: divider=right+1
    else: divider=left-1
